svg.title: Theory of Mind shortcuts and RFT attention
svg.desc: The benchmark shortcut chart and RFT attention heatmap, with a compact formulation of the shortcut audit in Section 2.1 of arXiv:2606.09092. Flag a dataset if a heuristic has accuracy at least 0.20 above the random/majority baseline with p-value below 0.05, or the mean normalized feature-label mutual information is at least 0.15. The displayed flag equation condenses the two criteria from the paper.

g.text: m: surface features · Y: correctness labels
